question: What form and situation characterize a liṅga comparable to the bāṇa-liṅga?
premises: The liṅga is situated with a flowing stream.
It has a form similar to the bāṇa-liṅga.
Both condition and likeness are stated together.
inference: A liṅga situated with a flowing stream and having a form similar to the bāṇa-liṅga is described.
uncertainties: The precise referent of satit+pravāha may depend on ritual context.
plain_english: And it is situated with a flowing stream, having a form similar to the bāṇa-liṅga.
